capabilities: Apply extension rules matching directory path, file content via regex, or both
Fix the extension of the current file via a command palette command
Read the true extension from the file path when other plugins spoof it
extras: Warns that Obsidian won't see non-.md files unless configured, that Sync must be set to process unsupported files, and that renaming fails when a file with the same name exists. Auto-run on save is off by default to avoid race conditions.
problem: Obsidian mostly ignores non-.md files, so users with MD-like filetypes have no automatic way to keep their extensions consistent.

summary: Rule-based tool that automatically renames file extensions using trickle-down rules matching directory path, file content regex, or both.
